ColumnMapping.description:
The versioned, confirmed mapping of one source table.

The document is deliberately explicit about every convention that a value
parser would otherwise have to guess: the date order, the timezone policy,
and how duplicates are treated. Nothing in the canonical pipeline infers
what this document can state.
ColumnMapping.title: ColumnMapping

ColumnRole.description:
The canonical role a source column plays in the observation model.

A role is a claim the analyst confirms, never a guess the parser makes.
``IGNORED`` marks a column that is read for the parse report but excluded
from the canonical dataset.
ColumnRole.title: ColumnRole

DateOrder.description:
The declared order of day, month, and year in a numeric date.

ISO 8601 dates are unambiguous and unaffected. A numeric date such as
``03/04/2024`` means different days under different conventions, so the
convention is declared in the column mapping instead of being guessed.

info.description:
The Trendsmapp scientific API.

Uploads are chunked and content-addressed, datasets are normalized into a
canonical observation model, and every analysis runs in the worker process.
Route handlers validate and delegate; they never perform scientific
computation.
info.summary: Validated environmental spatial analysis and machine learning.
info.title: Trendsmapp API
